facts.fact: BCEAO decision published 25 June 2026 set 30 September 2026 as the deadline for banks, e-money institutions and payment institutions of the WAEMU, which includes Cote d'Ivoire, to complete connection to PI-SPI and open services to the public (Agence Ecofin, 1 Oct 2026).

systems.tiers: banks, e-money institutions, payment institutions (deadline 30 Sept 2026)
